scores.notes: Shows Paul lecturing an invented audience on a terrace overlooking a Greek citadel instead of the verse's mirror imagery, introducing an uncalled-for speaker and crowd.

Faithfully depicts Holmes holding the blue carbuncle to the window light beside his open strongbox while Watson sits with his bowler hat and medical bag; clean anatomy and no lettering or screen-adaptation likenesses.
Depicts King Hezekiah in the Temple courtyard overseeing the service of God's house alongside a priest holding a blank scroll and busy temple workers; clean anatomy and no lettering.

Accurately illustrates Alice helping herself to tea and bread-and-butter while looking toward the Dormouse as the Hatter speaks and the March Hare sits by; yellow dress avoids the Disney blue dress and no lettering appears.
Depicts Moses on a rocky rise at Mount Horeb directing the Israelites as they break camp and set out toward the open country ahead, using only sunlit clouds rather than any figure for God.
Watson seated on the left unmistakably bears the likeness of screen actor Jude Law, and the printed slip he holds up to the window light shows unreadable horizontal pseudo-script lines.
The group marches straight away from the blazing whitewashed house with their backs turned to the fire instead of hastening toward it with the building in front of them.
Alice on the right has three arms—one extended gesturing across the table, a second reaching onto the loaf of bread, and a third resting straight down on the table edge.
Depicts King Darius by torchlight pressing his signet into clay on the roped stone slab laid over the lions' den while his lords, guards, and laborers stand around; clean anatomy and no lettering.

Faithfully shows Alice seated in the large armchair at one end of the table while the Hatter and March Hare crowd around the sleeping Dormouse at the opposite corner; unpainted white watercolor paper shows at the bottom and upper-right corners (accepted).

Clearly shows King Darius pressing his signet ring into a clay-and-cord seal bridging the stone slab and den rim while his lords wait with their seals and guards hold torches; clean anatomy and no lettering.

Shows Moses directing the departing Israelites and livestock away from cloud-ringed Mount Horeb without depicting God as a figure; unpainted white paper appears along the upper-left sky edge (accepted).
Depicts an ancient household filling a vaulted stone treasury with grain sacks, amphorae, and a chest of valuables without personifying Wisdom as a figure; clean anatomy and no lettering.

Vividly depicts giant Alice picking up spilled animal jurymen including Bill the Lizard after her skirt tips over the jury-box while the King gestures gravely from the bench; meets size, costume, and card-character rules with no lettering.

Faithfully illustrates the opening of the Mad Tea-Party with the Hatter resting his arm on the sleeping Dormouse beside the March Hare while an indignant Alice sits in the armchair at the opposite end of the tea-only table.
Depicts a massive billowing cloud resting directly over the Tabernacle while the Israelites remain encamped in tents across the desert valley; clean anatomy and no lettering.

Accurately depicts the ridged croquet-ground with Alice laughing as her flamingo twists to look at her, a hedgehog below, doubled-up flat card arches, and the furious Queen shouting behind; clean anatomy and no lettering.

Depicts a bustling ancient treasury being filled with gold, vessels, and grain without personifying Wisdom, but the small white tally slip held by the dark-bearded man on the right displays unreadable horizontal squiggle-script lines.

Accurately illustrates the priest in the Tabernacle courtyard casting feathers beside the burning horned bronze altar onto the ash pile without gore or any figure for God; clean anatomy and no lettering.
Faithfully depicts King Hezekiah in the Temple courtyard overseeing Levites handling blank scrolls and vessels beside the bronze sea on oxen; clean anatomy and no lettering.
Clearly shows a dense cloud hovering over the Tabernacle while Israelite families remain settled in camp life around their tents; clean anatomy and no lettering.

Dramatically depicts Moses and an armed attendant on a rocky ledge directing the Israelites breaking camp below cloud-shrouded Mount Horeb toward the sunlit plains, with no figure for God and clean anatomy.

Clearly illustrates Moses gesturing from cloud-ringed Mount Horeb as Israelite families and livestock set out along the road toward the distant hills, with no figure for God, no lettering, and sound anatomy.
Faithfully depicts the tearful Mock Turtle singing and the Gryphon dancing around Alice on the shingle beach while waving their forepaws; meets Alice costume and animal rules with no lettering.
Clearly shows the priest in the Tabernacle courtyard casting feathers beside the burning horned bronze altar into the ash pile without gore or any figure for God; clean anatomy and no lettering.

The flamingo's two hanging legs awkwardly cross and fuse into a single webbed foot cluster beside Alice's right shoe, and numerous players and guests around the Queen and lawn wear ordinary 18th-century dress rather than court-card dress or flat cards.

Three duplicate blue carbuncles appear simultaneously—held up in Holmes's right hand, held in his left hand, and resting on the windowsill—and the folded paper on the bottom-left desk bears faint unreadable pseudo-script lines.

Faithfully captures giant Alice reaching into the tipped jury-box to right the head-down Lizard while animal jurors scramble among scattered slates and the King gestures gravely from the bench; clean anatomy and no lettering.

Inserts a prominent standing prophet/narrator lecturing with a staff on the left whom the verse does not call for, even though the weary and kneeling Israelites looking toward heaven's light fit the text.

Frames the verse as Paul lecturing an invented Corinthian audience rather than depicting the imagery directly, and the open scroll on the bottom-right table contains unreadable squiggle-script lines; white unpainted paper appears at the corners (accepted).

Clearly depicts the priest casting feathers beside the burning horned bronze altar into the ash pile in the Tabernacle courtyard without gore or depicting God; watercolor washes vignette into white unpainted paper near the upper and lower corners (accepted).

Faithfully illustrates the priest casting feathers beside the burning horned bronze altar onto the ash pile in the Tabernacle courtyard while onlookers stand reverently by; clean anatomy, no gore, no lettering, and no figure for God.

Depicts Moses pointing out from cloud-capped Mount Horeb toward the open country ahead while Israelites pack tents and load donkeys, with no figure for God and clean anatomy; pale sky washes fade to white paper at the upper-left edge (accepted).
